# apple_game_center_leaderboard_localization (Resource)

Sets the name of a Game Center leaderboard, and how its scores are shown, for one locale; `apple_game_center_leaderboard_image` adds the locale's image. Changes go to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying starts the next one. Changes fail while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the localization from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<leaderboard_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard_localization" "en_US" {
  leaderboard_id            = apple_game_center_leaderboard.high_scores.id
  locale                    = "en-US"
  name                      = "High Scores"
  formatter_suffix          = " points"
  formatter_suffix_singular = " point"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Name of the leaderboard.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the leaderboard.
- `formatter_override` (String) How scores are shown in this locale, instead of the leaderboard's `default_formatter`, e.g. `MONEY_EURO`.
- `formatter_suffix` (String) Text after a score, e.g. ` points`.
- `formatter_suffix_singular` (String) Text after a score of one, e.g. ` point`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    leaderboard_id = "4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c"
    locale         = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_localization.en_US 4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c/en-US
```
